description: Generate a pixel landscape from a seed: sky by time of day, sun or moon, stars, clouds, mountains, hills, sea, forest, ground, rain. Uses the "scene" palette schema, so the same seed renders in any scene-* palette. Presets: dawn, home, school, night, sea, storm, window, forest, dusk, stars. Returns a canvas you can keep drawing on.

layers.description: Drawn back to front in a fixed order

palette.description: A scene-* palette (default scene-<preset>, or scene-dusk)

preset.description: Mood preset: sets time, layers and the default palette

name: landscape
